title: Nordic Curl
summary: A bodyweight hamstring exercise where you lower your torso forward from kneeling, loading the hamstrings hard as they lengthen.

muscles.why: Library rating 1 for hamstrings (main mover): each working set adds 1 of a set to the weekly hamstrings total.
Library rating 0.25 for calves (minor): each working set adds 0.25 of a set to the weekly calves total.
Library rating 0.2 for glutes: below the counting floor, so it adds nothing to the weekly glutes total.

setup.text: Kneel with your ankles anchored under a pad or by a partner.
Keeping your hips straight, lower your body forward as slowly as you can.
Catch yourself with your hands and push back up, or pull back up if you can.

form_cues.cue: Keep your body straight from knees to head
Lower as slowly as you can
Push up with your hands and pull back
Start with the slow lowering only. It's very hard, so expect soreness at first.

mistakes.text: Bending at the hips to shorten the lever.

lower_risk.text: Warm-up: the app adds no ramp-up sets; make the first working set a touch lighter if you like.
The app suggests a heavier load only when the jump is 10% or less; otherwise it adds a rep first.
Default target: 10-15 reps, stopping about 2 reps short of failure (RIR 2). Stop the set when form breaks down.
Use the same controlled range on every rep; lower under control rather than dropping or bouncing.
Pick a variation and range you can train comfortably.
